title: Cairo & Sharm El Sheikh — 07 Nights
intro: Two Egypts in a single week. On one side the Giza Plateau and the Grand Egyptian Museum, Old Cairo and medieval Al-Moez Street, closing with a Sufi performance over dinner. On the other, three all-inclusive nights on the Sinai coast — Naama Bay, Ras Muhammad, a parasail flight and the cliffside lanterns of Farsha. You begin and end in Cairo, with the Red Sea in between.

days.title: The Pyramids of Giza & the Grand Egyptian Museum
days.description:
Breakfast at your hotel, then meet your private Egyptologist guide.
The Giza Plateau: the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, and the panoramic viewpoint over all three.
The Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple of Khafre.
Lunch at a local restaurant overlooking the plateau.
The Grand Egyptian Museum — the hanging obelisk, the Ramses II atrium, the grand staircase and the complete Tutankhamun collection.
Transfer back to your hotel; evening at leisure.
Overnight in Cairo.

days.title: Cairo to Sharm El Sheikh — Soho Square & the Old Market
days.description:
Breakfast at your hotel and check-out.
Transfer to Sharm El Sheikh by private air-conditioned vehicle — roughly 6 hours by way of the Suez tunnel and the Sinai coast road, with comfort stops en route.
A one-hour domestic flight is available as an upgrade in place of the drive — quoted on request.
Arrival and check-in at your Naama Bay resort on an all-inclusive basis.
Evening out at Soho Square: the dancing fountain, the ice bar and the promenade.
On to the Old Market for spices, souvenirs and Egyptian coffee.
Overnight in Sharm El Sheikh.
days.hotel: Naama Bay, Sharm El Sheikh — 4★ resort (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Sharm El Sheikh at Leisure — Optional Ras Muhammad
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort.
A full day at leisure on an all-inclusive basis — private beach, pools, house reef and every resort facility at your disposal.
Optional, at extra cost: a full-day boat trip to Ras Muhammad National Park, with two swim stops over the Shark and Yolanda reefs and lunch served on board.
Ras Muhammad sits at the southern tip of Sinai, where the two gulfs of the Red Sea meet — the clearest water and the richest coral in Sinai.
Overnight in Sharm El Sheikh.

days.title: Parasailing, the Submarine & Farsha by Night
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort.
Parasail flight over the bay — a tandem or solo lift from the boat, with the reef line and the resort coast laid out below you.
A semi-submarine excursion: down to the glass observation deck to watch the coral gardens and reef fish through panoramic windows — no swimming and no experience needed.
Afternoon back at the resort at leisure.
Evening at Farsha Café — the cliffside terraces above the old town, all cushions and lanterns, and one of the best sunsets in Sinai.
Overnight in Sharm El Sheikh.
days.hotel: Naama Bay, Sharm El Sheikh — 4★ resort (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort and a relaxed final morning by the sea.
Lunch before departure.
Check-out and transfer back to Cairo by private air-conditioned vehicle — roughly 6 hours, with comfort stops en route.
A domestic flight is available as an upgrade in place of the drive — quoted on request.
Arrival and check-in at your Cairo hotel; evening at leisure.
Overnight in Cairo.

days.title: Egyptian Civilization, Old Cairo & a Farewell Dinner
days.description:
Breakfast at your hotel, then meet your private Egyptologist guide.
The National Museum of Egyptian Civilization in Fustat — the Royal Mummies Hall and five thousand years of Egypt in one gallery.
Lunch at a local restaurant.
Old Cairo on foot: the Hanging Church, the Church of St Sergius and the Ben Ezra Synagogue.
Al-Moez Ldin Allah Street — medieval Cairo past Bayt Al-Suhaymi, the Qalawun complex and the sabil-kuttabs, ending in Khan El-Khalili for tea and shopping.
Farewell dinner at Mamai with a live oriental show and a Sufi tanoura performance.
Overnight in Cairo.

arrival.title: Arrival in Cairo — Welcome Dinner
arrival.description:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport.
Meet & assist by our representative through visa, passport and customs formalities.
Private air-conditioned transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Check-in and time to freshen up after your journey.
Welcome dinner with your host — a first taste of Egyptian cooking and a walk-through of the days ahead.
Overnight in Cairo.

departure.title: Departure
departure.description:
Breakfast at your hotel (subject to flight timing).
Check-out and assistance with your luggage.
Private air-conditioned transfer to Cairo International Airport.
Final meet & assist through departure formalities — we wish you a safe journey home.
